briefdescription.para: getSrc - Returns the source instruction for this dependence.
getDst - Returns the destination instruction for this dependence.
isInput - Returns true if this is an input dependence.
isOutput - Returns true if this is an output dependence.
isFlow - Returns true if this is a flow (aka true) dependence.
isAnti - Returns true if this is an anti dependence.
isOrdered - Returns true if dependence is Output, Flow, or Anti
isUnordered - Returns true if dependence is Input
isLoopIndependent - Returns true if this is a loop-independent dependence.
isConfused - Returns true if this dependence is confused (the compiler understands nothing and makes worst-case assumptions).
isConsistent - Returns true if this dependence is consistent (occurs every time the source and destination are executed).
getLevels - Returns the number of common loops surrounding the source and destination of the dependence.
getDirection - Returns the direction associated with a particular level.
getDistance - Returns the distance (or NULL) associated with a particular level.
Check if the direction vector is negative.

detaileddescription.para: A negative direction vector means Src and Dst are reversed in the actual program.

briefdescription.para: If the direction vector is negative, normalize the direction vector to make it non-negative.

detaileddescription.para: Normalization is done by reversing Src and Dst, plus reversing the dependence directions and distances in the vector.

briefdescription.para: isPeelFirst - Returns true if peeling the first iteration from this loop will break this dependence.
isPeelLast - Returns true if peeling the last iteration from this loop will break this dependence.
isSplitable - Returns true if splitting this loop will break the dependence.
isScalar - Returns true if a particular level is scalar; that is, if no subscript in the source or destination mention the induction variable associated with the loop at this level.
getNextPredecessor - Returns the value of the NextPredecessor field.
getNextSuccessor - Returns the value of the NextSuccessor field.
setNextPredecessor - Sets the value of the NextPredecessor field.
setNextSuccessor - Sets the value of the NextSuccessor field.
dump - For debugging purposes, dumps a dependence to OS.
Dependence - This class represents a dependence between two memory memory references in a function.

detaileddescription.para: It contains minimal information and is used in the very common situation where the compiler is unable to determine anything beyond the existence of a dependence; that is, it represents a confused dependence (see also FullDependence). In most cases (for output, flow, and anti dependences), the dependence implies an ordering, where the source must precede the destination; in contrast, input dependences are unordered.

When a dependence graph is built, each Dependence will be a member of the set of predecessor edges for its destination instruction and a set if successor edges for its source instruction. These sets are represented as singly-linked lists, with the "next" fields stored in the dependence itelf.
